CITY COUNCIL AGENDA


Tuesday, October 20, 2026, 6:00 PM

1020 E. Pioneer Rd.

Draper, Utah 84020

6:00 PM STUDY SESSION (ADMINISTRATIVE CONFERENCE ROOM)

CLOSED MEETING, IF NECESSARY - TO BE ANNOUNCED IN MOTION

The Draper City Council may temporarily recess the meeting and convene in a closed meeting as provided by UCA § 52-4-205.

Discussion: Fleet Policy - Robert

Council Manager Reports

7:00 PM BUSINESS SESSION

1.	Call to Order

2.	Pledge of Allegiance

3.	Proclamation - Extra Mile Day

4.	Public Comments

To be considerate of everyone attending the meeting, public comments will be restricted to items that are not listed on this or a future agenda and limited to three minutes per person. Comments which cannot be made within these limits should be submitted in writing to the City Recorder prior to noon the day before the meeting. Comments pertaining to an item on the agenda should not be given at this time but should be held until that item is called.

5.	Consent Items

5.a Approve the Minutes of the October 6, 2026 City Council Meeting

5.b Approve Resolution #26-49

A resolution of the Draper City Council amending and extending an agreement with APC Towers. Staff: Spencer DuShane.

6.	Adjournment
 
I, the City Recorder of Draper City, certify that copies of this agenda for the Draper City Council meeting to be held October 20, 2026, were posted at Draper City Hall, Draper City website www.draperutah.gov, and the Utah Public Notice website at www.utah.gov/pmn.


Nicole Smedley, CMC, City Recorder Draper City, State of Utah

Posted on September 24, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Snow Zoning Map Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Draper City Council to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 960 E. New Hope Dr. The purpose of the request is to change the zoning designation from RA1 (Residential agricultural, 40,000 ft2 min. lot size) to RA2 (Residential agricultural, 20,000 ft2 min. lot size)

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on October 6, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Nick Whittaker, MCMP at (801) 576-6522 or nick.whittaker@draperutah.gov. 

Dated this 24th Day of September, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: Exchange 14068 South 145 East Development Agreement Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on September 3, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Exchange 14068 South 145 East Development Agreement Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the below bodies 
to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 14068 S. 145 East. The purpose of the request is to modify Draper City Municipal Code Title 9 standards to allow a building up to 60-feet in height and allow alternative architectural and parking standards. The request will allow a building to be built in the existing Exchange at 140th office complex which better aligns with what has already been built in the complex.

-	Planning Commission: September 10, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. 
-	City Council: September 15, 2026 at 7:00 p.m.

Both hearings will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Jennifer Jastremsky at Draper City offices, jennifer.jastremsky@draperutah.gov & 801-576-6328.

Dated this 3rd Day of September, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder
